decisions.reason: The multi-model line sits in the core safety-shoe business, and its tooling and range investment still argue for persistence after only two years.
After the supportive insole was withdrawn, the comfort insole is more exposed, but it costs little to keep and complements the core footwear, so a drop is not yet justified.
The ergonomic series has its own page and several models and fits the announced innovation direction, so investment and public commitment favour keeping it.
Costly certification and long tender cycles mean slow early results can be read as temporary, and the sunk costs favour persisting.
As the home-page flagship of the firm's direction, the moulded insole carries the strongest public commitment and need for justification.
